claims.claim: Severian of Gabala was bishop of Gabala in Syria and lived approximately from 355 to 408/425.
He was a popular preacher in Constantinople between about 400 and 404 and became a chief opponent of John Chrysostom, helping to condemn him at the Synod of the Oak.
The fragments survive only in later quotation collections (catenae) rather than as an independent manuscript.
